svg.title: Tandem-repeat length and gel migration
svg.desc: Schematic, not to scale. Ten duplexes contain one through ten repeat units, numbered individually on both-strand modules. Conserved flanks have two cleavage boundaries per row. All strands are antiparallel. Each corresponding gel strip has one purple band; longer fragments travel less far right. Original construction from the teaching facts in image_004.jpg; no base sequence or measured migration distance is implied.
